findings.title: GuardDuty is not enabled
findings.description: Amazon GuardDuty is not enabled in cn-north-1.
findings.impact: No continuous threat detection for account compromise, instance compromise, or reconnaissance.
remediationSteps: Enable GuardDuty in the AWS console or via API.

findings.title: Inspector is not enabled
findings.description: Amazon Inspector is not enabled in cn-north-1.
findings.impact: No automated vulnerability scanning for EC2 instances, Lambda functions, or container images.
remediationSteps: Enable Inspector in the AWS console.

findings.title: EC2 instance i-0abc123 has SSH (22) reachable from 0.0.0.0/0
findings.description: Instance i-0abc123 has SSH port 22 reachable from the internet via SG + NACL analysis.
findings.impact: SSH exposed to the internet increases brute-force and credential stuffing risk.
remediationSteps: Restrict port 22 to known IP ranges.
Use AWS Systems Manager Session Manager instead of SSH.

findings.title: IAM user admin-user can escalate privileges via iam:CreatePolicyVersion
findings.description: User admin-user has iam:CreatePolicyVersion permission which allows creating a new policy version with full admin access.
findings.impact: Privilege escalation to full administrator access.
remediationSteps: Remove iam:CreatePolicyVersion from the user's permissions.
Use AWS Organizations SCPs to prevent privilege escalation.

findings.title: EC2 instance i-0def456 missing required tag: Environment
findings.description: Instance i-0def456 is missing the required 'Environment' tag.
findings.impact: Cannot determine resource environment for cost allocation and access control.
remediationSteps: Add the 'Environment' tag with an appropriate value (e.g., production, staging, dev).

findings.title: EC2 instance i-0def456 missing required tag: Project
findings.description: Instance i-0def456 is missing the required 'Project' tag.
findings.impact: Cannot determine project ownership for cost allocation.
remediationSteps: Add the 'Project' tag with the appropriate project name.

findings.title: EC2 instance i-0def456 missing required tag: Owner
findings.description: Instance i-0def456 is missing the required 'Owner' tag.
remediationSteps: Add the 'Owner' tag with the responsible team or individual.

findings.title: Unattached EBS volume vol-0aaa111
findings.description: EBS volume vol-0aaa111 (100GB, gp3) is not attached to any instance.
findings.impact: Unused volume incurs storage costs and may contain stale data.
remediationSteps: Snapshot the volume if data is needed, then delete it.
Attach it to an instance if still required.

findings.title: Unused Elastic IP 1.2.3.4
findings.description: Elastic IP 1.2.3.4 is not associated with any instance or network interface.
remediationSteps: Release the Elastic IP if no longer needed.

findings.title: RDS instance mydb-prod does not have Multi-AZ enabled
findings.description: RDS instance mydb-prod is not configured for Multi-AZ deployment.
findings.impact: Single point of failure — an AZ outage will cause database downtime.
remediationSteps: Enable Multi-AZ for the RDS instance.
This provides automatic failover to a standby in a different AZ.

findings.title: [Security Hub] S3.8 — S3 Block Public Access setting should be enabled at the bucket level
findings.description: FSBP control S3.8: S3 Block Public Access not enabled at bucket level.
remediationSteps: Enable S3 Block Public Access at the bucket level.

findings.title: [Security Hub] EC2.2 — VPC default security group should not allow inbound or outbound traffic
findings.description: FSBP control EC2.2: Default VPC security group allows traffic.
findings.impact: Resources using the default security group may have unintended network access.
remediationSteps: Remove all inbound and outbound rules from the default security group.
